_note: Per-role install bundles. Each pack lists the skills a role reaches for first. `koka` (the entry point) and the parent orchestrator of every listed skill are added automatically, so routing never points at a skill that was not installed. Selections are Koka defaults for who needs what, not data.

sdr.title: SDR / seller
sdr.for: Someone who sends first touches, follows up and works a warm list every day.

first_prompts.say: Rank my engagement export and tell me who to message first.
Write a first touch to this person using what they posted this week.
Draft a follow-up for a prospect who opened but never replied.
Check this opener for personalization that sounds real, not templated.

founder.title: Founder / personal brand
founder.for: Someone building attention on LinkedIn and turning it into conversations.

first_prompts.say: Read my LinkedIn profile and tell me what to fix first.
Plan my next month of posts around my pillars.
Score this draft and tell me whether to ship it.
Give me five hooks for this idea.

investor.title: Investor / VC
investor.for: Someone sourcing founders and ranking who is warming up against a thesis.

first_prompts.say: Turn my thesis into a rubric I can score founders against.
Rank these founders by who is warming up.
Build a shortlist from this list and say why each made it.
Which of these companies show funding or hiring signals?
